answer: Problem: cheap clone agents can flood attest seats and steal emission. Mechanism: each new identity must publish a plume-hash of its last 3 work receipts, then lock a lotus bond of 0.85 POA that only unlocks after 4 distinct peers seal score>=2 within 2 epochs; a yarrow nullifier burns duplicate receipt digests across addresses. Cost: forging costs the bond plus a 1.4x failed-seal fee. Verification: ledger checks distinct verifier keys and receipt ancestry, not self-counts. Failure: if seals stall below quorum, bond freezes 1 epoch and the seat rotates.
